The '''Sil'Lume system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the system was ruled by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sebastian Parnell]].
